capabilities: Restyle panes, sidebars, tabs, quick switcher and code blocks with rounded corners and soft colors
Adjust pane radius, text width, text size, line height, paragraph spacing and heading scale
Hide the ribbon, status bar and note header with a hover-revealed header pill
Reuse Material Icon Theme for file-tab and Quick Switcher icons
Toggle the appearance on or off with a command without injecting runtime styles
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a chat or AI tool; it only changes the interface appearance and typography.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0+ on desktop; mobile is not supported. Recommends using the Default theme and warns that custom CSS snippets may conflict. Settings are bilingual (English/Chinese). MIT licensed; explicitly not affiliated with OpenAI.
problem: Obsidian's default workspace look is busy and visually inconsistent, and users have no built-in way to tune pane radius, spacing, or hide ribbon, status bar and note header.

relations.evidence: Vertically aligned Quick Switcher file icons, reusing Material Icon Theme when enabled
Inspired by the visual language of a user-provided ChatGPT desktop screenshot
If you use BRAT, add tarnish233/obsidian-quiet-chat as a beta plugin repository

summary: Appearance plugin that restyles the workspace with rounded panes, soft colors, aligned tabs, Typora-style typography, and optional hiding of UI elements.
